en.headline: Firefighters and SPCA rescue three kittens from Yau Ma Tei courtyard
en.dek: The young cats, estimated at two to three months old, were freed from a vacant shop's light well on Shanghai Street after a cat volunteer reported faint meowing around midday.
body: Firefighters and staff from the Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals rescued three kittens from a courtyard inside a vacant ground-floor shop on Shanghai Street in Yau Ma Tei on Saturday afternoon, reports said.

A cat volunteer heard faint meowing from the empty premises at around noon and called for help. Firefighters forced the metal gate and, with SPCA personnel using nets and other tools, located the kittens deep in the light well and brought them out.

The kittens, believed to be local short-haired siblings about two to three months old, showed no visible injuries. They were handed to the volunteer for care at a cattery. Fire Services later reminded the public not to attempt rescues themselves and to contact the department or relevant agencies if animals are trapped in dangerous places.
Police were also present at the scene while the rescue was under way.

zh.headline: 油麻地上海街天井三幼貓獲救 消防愛協合力破門
zh.dek: 中午時分貓義工報稱空置地舖傳出微弱貓聲，消防破門後與愛協救出約兩至三個月大幼貓，交義工照料。
body: 報道指，周六下午消防員及愛護動物協會人員在油麻地上海街一間空置地舖天井救出三隻幼貓。
一名貓義工中午時分聽到空置舖內傳出微弱貓叫聲後報警求助。消防員撬開鐵閘進入，愛協人員攜帶貓網等工具協助，最終在天井深處找到並救出幼貓。
獲救幼貓估計為本地短毛貓，約兩至三個月大，相信是兄弟姊妹，並無表面傷痕，其後交由貓義工帶往貓舍照料。消防處提醒市民發現動物被困危險地方時切勿自行冒險，應聯絡消防或相關部門。
救援期間警員亦在場調查。
